## Commands

## `link-reachability`

Explicitly check external HTTP(S) destinations; results are advisory

```text
Explicitly check external HTTP(S) destinations; results are advisory

Usage: link-reachability [OPTIONS] <input>

Arguments:
  <input>
          Markdown file or JSON array of destinations

Options:
      --input-format <input-format>
          [default: markdown]
          [possible values: markdown, json]

      --max-checks <max-checks>
          [default: 20]

      --timeout <timeout>
          Maximum seconds per unique destination including redirects

          [default: 5]

      --telemetry
          Emit aggregate counts to stderr

  -h, --help
          Print help
```

## `content-change`

Evaluate a content-gate change and write a bound verdict

```text
Evaluate a content-gate change and write a bound verdict

Usage: content-change [OPTIONS] --preset <preset>

Options:
      --preset <preset>
          Explicit content preset name

      --preset-source <preset-source>
          Load a named TOML preset as NAME=PATH; may be repeated

      --content-root <content-root>
          Authorize this absolute content root for local file references (Linux and supported macOS kernels)

      --extension-results <extension-results>
          Load explicitly supplied, input-bound external gate results for change entries

      --plain-text-paragraphs
          Interpret text/plain entries as blank-line-separated paragraphs

      --check-link-reachability
          Explicitly enable bounded external HTTP observations for reachability gates

      --link-max-checks <link-max-checks>
          Maximum external link checks across the entire change

          [default: 20]

      --link-timeout <link-timeout>
          Maximum seconds per external link including redirects

          [default: 5]

      --telemetry
          Emit aggregate link observation counts to stderr

  -h, --help
          Print help
```

## `content`

Run a portable content preset on a UTF-8 file or stdin

```text
Run a portable content preset on a UTF-8 file or stdin

Usage: content [OPTIONS] [path]

Arguments:
  [path]
          [default: -]

Options:
      --preset <preset>
          [default: article]

      --preset-source <preset-source>
          Load a named TOML preset as NAME=PATH; may be repeated

      --metadata <metadata>
          JSON file containing string metadata fields

      --check-link-reachability
          Explicitly enable bounded external HTTP link observations for configured reachability gates

      --link-max-checks <link-max-checks>
          Maximum unique external link checks

          [default: 20]

      --link-timeout <link-timeout>
          Maximum seconds per external link including redirects

          [default: 5]

      --extension-results <extension-results>
          Load explicitly supplied, input-bound external gate results as JSON

      --export-adapter-input
          Print the projected content input as JSON; may contain private content

      --evidence-source <evidence-source>
          Load a named UTF-8 source snapshot as NAME=PATH; may be repeated

      --site <site>
          Load a static website for site gates

      --collection <collection>
          Load a complete JSON array of content items for collection gates

      --collection-incomplete
          Treat the supplied collection as incomplete and retain observed findings without certifying uniqueness

      --site-config <site-config>
          Existing site audit config file

      --crawl-url <crawl-url>
          Crawl a website and evaluate the preset against its snapshot

      --crawl-config <crawl-config>
          Existing crawl configuration file

      --crawl-max-pages <crawl-max-pages>
          Maximum pages to crawl

          [default: 200]

      --crawl-engine <crawl-engine>
          Crawl engine

          [default: http]
          [possible values: http, playwright]

      --input-format <input-format>
          Interpret content as raw text, blank-line-separated paragraphs, Markdown, or static HTML

          [default: text]
          [possible values: text, paragraph-text, markdown, html]

      --telemetry
          Write local evaluation timing and aggregate counts as JSON to stderr

      --fix
          Apply supported safe fixes to a local file

      --no-text
          Do not read a text input

      --list-site-groups
          List native website groups usable in presets

      --list-presets
          List available preset names

      --explain
          Print the resolved preset as TOML (or JSON with --format json) without reading content

      --format <format>
          [default: text]
          [possible values: text, json]

  -h, --help
          Print help
```

## `check`

Run static checks against a site directory

```text
Run static checks against a site directory

Usage: check [OPTIONS] [path]

Arguments:
  [path]
          [default: .]

Options:
      --config <config>


      --baseline <baseline>


      --regressions-only


      --format <format>
          [default: text]
          [possible values: text, json, sarif]

      --a11y-strict
          Strict mode for the accessibility axis: A11Y001 fires on every <img> without alt regardless of role/aria-hidden. Default is smart mode (skips canonically decorative images). Equivalent to [accessibility].strict = true in config.

  -h, --help
          Print help
```

## `crawl`

Run runtime checks against a served website

```text
Run runtime checks against a served website

Usage: crawl [OPTIONS] <url>

Arguments:
  <url>


Options:
      --seed <seed>


      --seed-file <seed-file>
          Seed every page URL on the target's origin from a link inventory JSON file and record a crawl attestation in the audit artifact

      --release-header <release-header>
          Record each HTML page's release marker from this response header and attest it in the audit artifact; takes precedence over --release-meta

      --release-meta <release-meta>
          Record each HTML page's release marker from the content of <meta name=NAME> and attest it in the audit artifact

      --include-pattern <include-pattern>


      --exclude-pattern <exclude-pattern>


      --no-sitemap-seed


      --ignore-robots
          Crawl URLs that robots.txt disallows; only for auditing a site you own

      --max-pages <max-pages>
          [default: 200]

      --link-graph-output <link-graph-output>
          Write an observational link graph report to this JSON file

      --link-graph-context <link-graph-context>
          Compare the link graph report with this audit link context file instead of the --seed-file inventory

      --link-graph-summary
          Include an observational link graph coverage summary in the crawl output

      --link-graph-telemetry
          Emit aggregate link graph timing and counts to stderr

      --checkpoint <checkpoint>


      --resume <resume>


      --checkpoint-every <checkpoint-every>
          [default: 25]

      --artifact-every <artifact-every>
          [default: 25]

      --artifact-min-interval-ms <artifact-min-interval-ms>
          [default: 15000]

      --partial-audit-every <partial-audit-every>
          [default: 100]

      --partial-audit-min-interval-ms <partial-audit-min-interval-ms>
          [default: 60000]

      --retry-budget <retry-budget>
          [default: 2]

      --progress <progress>
          [default: plain]
          [possible values: plain, json, off]

      --config <config>


      --perf-budget <perf-budget>
          Fail the runtime command when a JSON performance budget is exceeded

      --baseline <baseline>


      --regressions-only


      --engine <engine>
          [possible values: auto, http, playwright]

      --format <format>
          [default: text]
          [possible values: text, json, sarif]

      --cf-access-id <cf-access-id>
          Cloudflare Access service-token Client ID (or env CF_ACCESS_CLIENT_ID); injected as CF-Access-Client-Id header on every fetch

      --cf-access-secret <cf-access-secret>
          Cloudflare Access service-token Client Secret (or env CF_ACCESS_CLIENT_SECRET); injected as CF-Access-Client-Secret header on every fetch

      --a11y-strict
          Strict mode for the accessibility axis: A11Y001 fires on every <img> without alt regardless of role/aria-hidden. Default is smart mode (skips canonically decorative images). Equivalent to [accessibility].strict = true in config.

  -h, --help
          Print help
```

## `intelligence`

Run higher-level GEO intelligence analyses

```text
Run higher-level GEO intelligence analyses

Usage: intelligence [COMMAND]

Commands:
  grounding-map  Infer page topics, grounding intents, and answer-coverage gaps

  fanout         Assess deterministic answer-engine query fan-out coverage
  facts          Assess structured facts readiness and cross-surface consistency [aliases: truth]

  surfaces       Discover machine-readable website surfaces and retrieval paths

          Print help
```
